name: BACH_0028
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, backbone agreement, and 5/5 neighbors support tier-4 priority [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%, Normal 0%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Strong benign score; zero invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign}, α=0.10 (90% dataset coverage, n=132) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability (AUROC 0.70), 76th OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical input; no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent backbones match top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign (85%–91%); contrast Normal BACH_0114 (83%) [F5] | All nearest neighbors are benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 2, 4) · ↓ invasive · High text score (1.79, contrib −0.80) [F2]; caption mismatch, 18/20 check · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 5, 8, 10) · ↓ invasive · High score (1.22, contrib −0.61) [F3]; 20/20 spot-checked · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Low score (−0.05, contrib −0.58) [F4]; 19/20 spot-checked · Validated
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 0, 3, 10) · context · 70% epithelial (86th percentile, wrong-direction), 21% neoplastic-called (705/mm²), 83rd-percentile shape CV · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set: top-3 risk removal beats random (+0.0114, CI 0.0021–0.0197; all regions here 0%).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.0008, CI −0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); minor/contrast concepts `mitoses` (0/20), `necrosis` (3/20), `normal_lobules` (0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Well-differentiated tubular neoplasia or duct-confined atypia (region 0 contrib +0.32, Weak 12/20) mimics benign tubules.
- HoVer-Net neoplastic calls (24–37 nuclei in regions 0, 3, 10) reflect true atypia, or tissue is Normal (BACH_0114).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 2, 4**: Confirm benign two-layered tubules and absent invasion (region 1 invasion score 0.04).
2. **Regions 0, 3, 10**: Inspect HoVer-Net neoplastic calls (24–37 nuclei), region 0 ductal atypia, and lymphocytes (Weak 8/20).
3. **Regions 5, 8, 9**: Verify benign stroma/fat (regions 5, 8) and rule out pleomorphism (region 9).
